config.t0_rule: rolling 90-candle median of eligible+valid-z count >= 25, first sustained crossing

hypothesis: Coverage diagnostic: per-candle count of ELIGIBLE names with valid ratio data and with valid W=90 z-scores, all 4 ratio panels; determines honest window T0 per pre-registered rule (30d rolling median of names with valid core z >= 25).

Core retail-fade baseline: per-coin z of log ls_accounts (W=90, min_periods=45, clip 3), fade sign, no EMA, XS-demean over eligible non-NaN names. Expect positive honest-window (2023-01-13+) Sharpe at 1x with funding tailwind.
W plateau: crowding-extreme fade should hold across 15-60d z-windows; kill if sign flips across adjacent W (no stable horizon).
EMA smoothing E in {3,6,12} on W in {45,90} cuts turnover (144-171/yr at E=1) and lifts 2x-stress Sharpe without killing 1x edge; signal is slow so smoothing should be near-free.
XS transform: centered-rank vs demean at (W=90,E=3) and (W=45,E=3). Rank should be similar or slightly more robust (outlier-z insensitive); large divergence would flag fragility.

Panel swaps at (W=90,E=3,demean), FADE sign only: tt_ls_accounts (semi-crowd) weaker than ls_accounts; tt_ls_positions (smart book) near zero or negative under fade; taker_ls_vol fade weak/ambiguous. Pre-commitment: no sign flips — follow-sign variants belong to other families and are dropped.

Smart-dumb spread s = z(tt_ls_positions) - z(ls_accounts) (fade retail vs smart anchor, pre-registered brief section 3): should beat the pure retail-fade since e06 showed the smart leg carries opposite-sign information (fade of it = -0.99 hw).

Section-6.3 combo gate: equal-weight (a) core+spread and (b) core+tt_ls_accounts-fade must beat the best single (core W90E3) on BOTH cost tiers to be adopted; expectation is NO (components weaker and correlated) -> keep single-signal core.

Final-config validation for (ls_accounts, W=90, E=3, rank): all plateau neighbors (W45/W135 at E3, E1/E6 at W90) positive; honest-window regime Sharpes positive in >=2 of 3 available regime classes; first-half vs second-half honest window both positive; funding attribution positive.
Robustness of final config (ls_accounts,W=90,E=3,rank): stable to min_periods {30,60}, clip {2,4}, and to an EXTRA 1-candle signal lag (slow-structure test; a large drop would flag timing fragility).
